meaning: non-finite pose/keypoint values in >5% of frames
shorter than 3s — cannot contain a fold
over 1% of frames have a hand moving >10 m/s — the tracker is jumping, not the person
head jumps >20 m/s in one frame — SLAM relocalised mid-episode
a hand is held >45 deg off the camera axis for most of the episode
more than 3x the median episode length — an un-segmented recording, not one demo
under 15% of the median episode length — a fragment, not a demo
union of all rules over 572 episodes
